question: Point out which of the following is a characteristic of cerebellar ataxia:

options.opc: The imbalance worsens when the patient closes his eyes (Romberg + sign).

reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "Cerebellar ataxia" -> "affects coordination and balance" -> "causes uncoordinated movements" -> "affects gait and posture" -> "may lead to wide-based stance" -> "may cause intention tremor" -> "may result in dysmetria" -> "possible defect of proprioceptive sensitivity" -> "possible Romberg + sign" -> 80%

enhanced_information: A characteristic of cerebellar ataxia is the imbalance worsening when the patient closes his eyes (Romberg + sign), which is supported by the chain of symptoms affecting coordination, balance, gait, and posture. There is a possible defect of proprioceptive sensitivity associated with cerebellar ataxia, leading to dysmetria. Rigidity is not a characteristic typically seen in cerebellar ataxia.
analysis: Cerebellar ataxia is characterized by a lack of coordination and balance due to dysfunction in the cerebellum. One of the classic features of cerebellar ataxia is the worsening of imbalance when the patient closes their eyes, known as the Romberg sign. This is due to the reliance on visual input to compensate for the impaired proprioception. While there may be a defect in proprioceptive sensitivity leading to dysmetria, rigidity is not a typical feature of cerebellar ataxia.
